statement_raw: Every finite integral domain is a field
The direct product of two groups is a group
Polynomial rings over a field are principal ideal domains
Every nonzero vector space has a basis
A continuous function on a compact space attains its maximum
The limit of a uniformly convergent sequence of continuous functions is continuous
Lebesgue measure of a countable set is zero
Every Cauchy sequence of real numbers converges
There are infinitely many prime numbers
For all natural numbers a and b, gcd(a,b) divides a and b
Every positive integer greater than 1 has a prime factor
The union of two sets is commutative
The power set of a set is partially ordered by inclusion
Cantor's theorem: no surjection from a set to its power set
The continuous image of a connected space is connected
A product of compact spaces is compact (Tychonoff, finite case)
The composition of two monomorphisms is a monomorphism
A Banach space is a complete normed vector space
The derivative of x ↦ x^n is n * x^(n-1)
